{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to account for risk aversion and mean reversion.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes (last 3-5 days) when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to capture momentum.",
    "Apply a 1-2 day lag correction for downward trends — model often overreacts to recent lows.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp upward spikes by applying a 10-15% dampening factor to avoid overcorrection.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending upward, shift forecast horizon slightly earlier to align with sentiment-driven momentum.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, apply a mean-reversion bias toward historical 15-day average if deviation exceeds ±15% from recent trend.",
    "If true outcome is significantly below forecast (e.g., >20% underperformance), reduce next-period forecast by 5-10% to reflect persistent downward bias.",
    "If sentiment is positive but forecast is consistently below true outcome, increase forecast by 5-10% to capture sentiment-driven upside potential."
  ]
}
